data.reportText: Intel Corporation Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  10/29/2026 after market close.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  13 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $0.27.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $0.11.
data.heading: INTC Earnings Date

text: INTC has a "high" Earnings Quality Ranking (EQR) for the 10th consecutive week. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. EQR is a weekly ranking of relative earnings quality for a large universe of publicly traded US equities. Companies are compared to peers in their industry. Find out more about EQR data.
